name: Appie
tagline: Your AI marketing stack that learns your brand
description: Appie is an AI marketing stack for agencies, growth teams, marketers, and founders. Add your website so Appie can learn your positioning, voice, and offers. Appie supports content creation, website chatbots, event-triggered email, creator campaigns, marketplace monitoring, and social workflows. It can find relevant Reddit threads and X mentions and draft on-brand replies and posts for you to review. Appie never publishes on its own, and it is not real-time. A free tier includes 500 one-time signup credits; optional paid plans start at $19/month.
